title: See it working
description: The same screens you will use, from measuring to delivery.

items.label: Measure
items.title: Measure with your phone
items.description: A hands-free body scan guides you by voice and takes your measurements in about a minute. Only an outline of you is sent, never a photo.

items.label: Shop
items.title: Ready to wear, in your size
items.description: Shop stores from Nigerian makers. Your measurements suggest the size to pick, so it fits when it arrives.

items.label: Design
items.title: Design it in the studio
items.description: Pick the styles and a fabric and the AI draws your outfit. Send it to tailors you choose and pick the quote you like.

items.label: Track
items.title: Follow it to your door
items.description: Every courier scan reaches you as an update, from collection to delivery. If an order ships late, you are credited automatically.
